scenarios.name: Open Ribbon customization from the Sketch panel title

scenario_steps.name: a part has an active editable sketch in the MCAD Software
the user opens Customize User Commands from the Create panel title context menu
the Customize dialog opens on the Ribbon tab
Ribbon, Keyboard and Marking Menu tabs are available
the command source is All Commands
the target command list is empty
the user closes the dialog without making changes
the editable sketch remains active and unchanged
